title: ‘Prague doesn’t want Nazis’: Activists block Slovak far-right MEP from conference about deporting immigrants
lede: In a heavily guarded Prague hotel, anti-migrant ideologues from Germany, Hungary and Czech Republic rallied together in support of a petition to deport foreigners that was rejected by the EU on rights grounds. MEP Milan Mazurek, previously convicted of inciting hatred towards Roma, was stopped from going inside by antifascist protesters.
